messages:
alex: Quick sync  we need to finalize scope for next week's ISV/tooling sprint: LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters, gateway contract, orchestration samples. Who can list gaps by EOD?
rita: I'll take LangChain + LlamaIndex compat. Checklist: auth, streaming signature, sample prompts, function-calling examples.
sam: I'll run gateway adapter contract + CI matrix (py/node/java). Need supported runtimes for gateway (edge vs managed).
jordan: Marketing note: co-announcement window tight. If eng needs >2w for docs/samples we should push announce. @alex timeline?
marie: Demo infra: partners want sandbox creds vs ephemeral tokens? Need tenant for sprint week.
paul: Adapter sketch from FlowBridge POC: ```class Adapter:
 def __init__(self, cfg): pass
 def stream(self, prompt, on_token): pass
 def embed(self, docs): return [float]``` Keep errors stable (429/503/400).
rita: Add small eval harness (~100 prompts) to catch regressions after quant builds. Sam, can CI run this?
sam: Yes. CI: smoke + eval against pinned model; fail on >X degradation. Need eval set from partnerships.
alex: If aim announce May 18, engineering needs final assets by May 3 (2w buffer).
jordan: Marketplace/legal approvals ~3-5 bd days. Recommend announce May 25 to be safe.
marie: Engbot can create sandbox tenant?
engbot: deploy-bot: Sandbox "tooling-sprint-2524" created. Admin creds in 1Password Partnerships/Sprints. TF PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sandboxes/pulls/432
paul: Should adapter expose health-check and supported-variants for fallback routing (quant -> full)? Affects contract.
alex: Yes. Sam add health-check + variants metadata to proto.
sam: Will post proto-API doc tomorrow AM.
jordan: I'll prep release blurb and partner checklist for PMM/legal.
marie: Who on-call during demo week? Rotate SRE/infra + one partnerships eng.
paul: I'll take days 1-2, then handoff.
alex: Action items: Rita samples+eval, Sam gateway+CI, Paul adapter proto+on-call, Jordan comms, Marie sandbox, Engbot infra PR. Update thread when posted. :thumbsup:
